entry.title: RICPE: filing corroborated by Ethical Channel and native platform email
entry.summary: Gil Marer, writing from San Cristóbal de La Laguna, submitted a formal communication through the RICPE Ethical Channel on 17 August 2026. Submission is corroborated by the final platform screen and a native platform email timestamped 17 August 2026, 22:51:17 UTC confirming the communication and assignment of a private follow-up code. The contemporaneous Gmail chain also preserves a digitally signed 22-page PDF, 447,975 bytes, SHA-256 b455075ceda7841471ef5f4ebfbb784ccd00357439aa8bf282e736fe4757832c, whose cryptographic signature validates. That signed PDF differs materially from the earlier 21-page V6 baseline; it is therefore preserved as a later signed object and strong candidate for the filed attachment, while exact byte identity with the channel attachment remains pending platform metadata or certificate evidence. Admission, investigation, conflict screening, preservation measures, Board treatment and merits are not yet established. Access credentials remain private.

entry.title: RICPE / Sun Park / Orion: governance, finance, ERDF, Portfolio and CNMV
entry.summary: The controlled record moves from a linear reading to a documented architecture of governance, knowledge, management and finance. José Acosta Matos sat on the RICPE board before the 2020 Sun Park investor communications; RICPE’s July-2021 record documents fragmented title and conditionality; RICPE founded Orion and the Issue Document describes a 17% RICPE convertible participating-finance channel; AGM is identified as strategic/asset manager and the related-person disclosure reconnects JDAM with FMMM, Shaila Cogolludo, Antonio Cogolludo and Pamalexsha/related interests already present in the Sun Park record. Portfolio confirmed an internal investigation, CNMV said filing 2024136159 would be processed as a consultation, and MYND’s permanent plaque expressly identifies ERDF. The specific asset/value trail from Sun Park/MYND/LPB/Matkator into Orion remains open.

entry.title: Three-level LAJ supervisory chain activated
entry.summary: The same corpus was registered with the Canary Islands High Court Government Secretariat, the Las Palmas Provincial Coordination Secretariat and the national Secretariat-General for preservation, identification and reconstruction of the LAJ documentary chain. Registration does not mean that an investigation has opened.
